v72.uniform_seizable_covering: Exact metric and family-covering transfer with fixed processor and ambient-domain one-use left inverse; full submaximal-error rank-state corollary.

v73.conditional_states: Additive preparation rank dimension V yields log(1+K/delta)+(V/2)logN+Vlog(1/delta)+O(1), fixed ranks/dimension and small error, uniform visibility.
v73.finite_adaptive_modulus: Complete finite-distance upper and GHZ-block lower proof with absolute constants uniform in N, public lambda, and angle.
v73.noise_sequence_exponents: Continuous horizon coefficient (1+min(alpha,1))/2 when 1-lambda_N^2=N^-alpha+o(1) approaches zero; weak-visibility exponent max(1/2-beta,0).
v73.noise_uniform_covering: C_all and rational-circle C are comparable to 1+K/delta for 0<delta<=2^-10, K=lambda*sqrt(N*min(N,1/(1-lambda^2))); erased endpoint singleton.
v73.rational_codec: Exact rational circle factors, integer precision decision, CP/TP Choi assembly, conditional rank nonincrease and canonical target replay.

new_claims.contact: Written boundary-depth trichotomy, including critical logarithmic enhancement.
new_claims.joint_metric: Written finite-use proof for the entire unbiased binary qubit ball, including unequal visibilities and endpoints.
new_claims.joint_rational_code: Implemented and proved rational disk/ball code for Cartesian rational input, including irrational norm. Both visibility and direction are charged.
new_claims.weighted_covering: Written Ahlfors-regular local weighted-volume criterion with arbitrary legal lower centres.
